_isEnabled.title: Enable Launch New Window
_isEnabled.description: Opens the course in its own browser window, for platforms that run it inside a frame

_stopSessionInitialize.title: Leave the LMS session to the course window
_stopSessionInitialize.description: Stops the launching window starting a SCORM session, so only the course window tracks to the LMS. Keep this on unless the platform needs otherwise

_activeOnPages.title: Active on pages
_activeOnPages.description: Only open a new window when the course is launched from a page matching one of these. Defaults to index_lms.html, the page an LMS launches. Leave empty for every page

_activeOnSelector.title: Active on browsers or devices
_activeOnSelector.description: Only open a new window when the page's html element matches this selector, e.g. .os-ios for iPhone and iPad, or .os-ios, .os-android for both. Leave empty for every browser and device

_target.title: Window name
_target.description: The name given to the course window

_strWindowFeatures.title: Window features
_strWindowFeatures.description: The window features passed to window.open. {{width}} and {{height}} are the available screen size

_delay.title: Delay before opening (milliseconds)
_delay.description: How long the launching window shows its message before opening the course window

preLaunchTitle.title: Before launch title
preLaunchTitle.default: The course should now open in a new browser window.

preLaunchBody.title: Before launch body
preLaunchBody.description: {{href}} is the course window's address, for a link the learner can use if a popup blocker stops the window opening
preLaunchBody.default: If this does not occur, please deactivate any popup blocking software - then click here or refresh this page to try again.

launchTitle.title: Launched title
launchTitle.default: The course should now be open in a new browser window.

launchBody.title: Launched body
launchBody.default: Please ensure you don't close or do anything in this window whilst the course is in progress.

closedBody.title: Closed body
closedBody.default: Please close this window to continue.
